description: Defines the BrowserTypeDispatcher class which manages browser type operations such as launch, connect over CDP, and persistent context creation within the Playwright core server dispatchers.

classes.name: BrowserTypeDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing browser type operations, including launching browsers, connecting over CDP, and creating persistent contexts.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a new browser instance with specified parameters, unless launching is denied.

methods.name: launchPersistentContext
methods.description: Creates a persistent browser context with specified parameters, unless launching is denied.

methods.name: connectOverCDP
methods.description: Connects to a browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) endpoint.

methods.name: connectOverCDPTransport
methods.description: Connects to a browser over a CDP transport.
